conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, aiming for steady, low-drawdown performance.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 1% to maintain a small, controlled leveraged exposure.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It blends broad index exposure with quality tech and a small amount of leverage, seeking growth while managing overall portfolio risk.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, targeting 6% each, to increase leveraged exposure.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It uses and adds to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to remove all leveraged ETF exposure.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to increase income-generating exposure.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions. It rotates into income-focused ETFs and broad index, cutting leverage and high-beta names. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
